name: ai-content-studio
description: AI Content Studio — generate articles, social posts, YouTube scripts, images, summaries, titles and SEO descriptions.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @studio/web" "npm run dev --workspace @studio/api"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:start && npm run db:push --workspace @studio/api && npm run db:seed --workspace @studio/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @studio/web && npm run build --workspace @studio/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @studio/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @studio/api
